# About {.page-title}

I'm an M.S. candidate in Psychology: Data Science in Human Behavior at UW–Madison (expected Dec 2026), with a B.S. in Psychology (neuroscience concentration, sociology minor) from UW–Parkside.

I build AI systems from start to finish: multi-agent document pipelines, transformer fine-tuning and calibration, LLM evaluation, computer vision classification, and behavioral prediction models. Before graduate school I spent five years in high-volume logistics and operations, working on quality assurance, documentation, and process improvement. That background is why I care about error rates, reproducibility, and cost as much as accuracy.

## Technical Skills

::: {.skills}
**Programming Languages**
: Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face), R, MATLAB, SQL, Parquet, Git

**Machine Learning**
: Transformer fine-tuning, model evaluation & calibration, cross-validation, SHAP/feature importance, error analysis, computer vision (OCR-based document classification), experimental design

**AI Engineering & Development**
: LangGraph, multi-agent pipelines, prompt engineering, LLM eval harnesses & LLM-as-a-judge, model serving (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter), ONNX + FastAPI deployment on Modal

**Engineering & Cloud**
: Docker, pytest, Quarto, AWS, Azure
:::
